newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-1st Boston cuts Genl Dynamics.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-1st Boston cuts Genl Dynamics.

text.p: CS First Boston analyst Peter Aseritis said he cut his rating of General Dynamics Corp to a hold from a buy rating because the stock was approaching his price target of $80 a share.
Aseritis said that he does not see good internal investment opportunities for the company that would exceed the cost of capital.
The analyst noted that General Dynamics is expected to receive $1.5 billion in cash from settlements with the U.S. Navy and the Internal Revenue Service.
However, the stock price of potential acquisition targets has risen, he said.
General Dynamics stock was off $0.875 to $75.50 in morning trade on the New York Stock Exchange.
